# The OCI CLI for the stack's VM (Ubuntu 22.04, aarch64, Python 3.10), every package pinned by hash.
# firstboot.sh installs it into a venv with pip --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary :all:.
# oci-cli caps click at 8.1.2 on Python < 3.11 and allows 8.3.3+ from 3.11 on, with the same code. The override
# takes the fixed click (8.3.3+, PYSEC-2026-2132) on 3.10 as well; --no-deps keeps pip from re-checking the cap.
# Regenerate: echo oci-cli > in.txt && echo 'click==8.5.0' > click-override.txt && uv pip compile in.txt \
#   --override click-override.txt --generate-hashes --python-version 3.10 \
#   --python-platform aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --no-header -o deploy/oci/oci-cli-requirements.txt
